spec: Hero skills (sim/hero/skills, combat/actions). Three branches. Each skill: branch, level (hero level to learn), max rank, spark (cost from your spark bar), cd (cooldown s), kind (what combat does: cleave, whirl, lunge, bolt, nova, mend, cry, bulwark, volley), and per-rank numbers: mult (x weapon damage), radius/reach px, dur (s), heal (share of max health). One skill point each level; slots Q, R, F hold three learned skills. The dodge (Shift) is always yours.

skills.name: Cleave
skills.desc: A wide, heavy swing that hits everything in front of you.

skills.name: Whirlwind
skills.desc: Spin with your blade out, striking all around you three times.

skills.name: Lunge
skills.desc: Dash forward and run through the first foe in your way.

skills.name: Spark bolt
skills.desc: Throw a mote of your own fire. Despair-born take double.

skills.name: Rekindle
skills.desc: Breathe on your own coals: mend a share of your health over a few seconds.

skills.name: Flame nova
skills.desc: Burst into flame: burn everything around you and push it back.

skills.name: War cry
skills.desc: A shout that staggers foes around you and steels your nerve.

skills.name: Bulwark
skills.desc: Set your feet: take far less harm for a while.

skills.name: Ember volley
skills.desc: Loose a fan of five burning shots.
